# 思印氣訣法-唐

**ID:** KR5c0266
**Custom ID:** ZB5c0257

**Editions:** SJB, ZHDZ

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Dharma of Meditative Mind, Seal, and Breath Instructions*

Anonymous; Táng

A Táng **exorcistic-ritual text** combining meditation (*sī* 思), ritual seal (*yìn* 印), and breath (*qì* 氣) techniques. The **Yellow God Yuè Seal** (*Huáng shén yuè zhāng* 黃神越章) already mentioned by [葛洪](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%91%9B%E6%B4%AA) Gé Hóng in the *Bào pǔ zǐ* 17 is central here. Preserved as **DZ 869** / CT 869.

**Dating.** Táng. Dynasty: 唐.
